title: phaeomeria heyneana

This plant is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine due to its potential health benefits, including its use as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
